**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE).**

Section 18 satisfies every preferred element:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§ 18.1)
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§ 18.1)
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5,000,000, granted unconditionally rather than only where Vendor processes Customer Data, which is broader than our preferred ask (§ 18.1)
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law (§ 18.1)
- **Certificates on request** — § 18.2

Section 18.1 also adds term-plus-one-year duration, at-Vendor's-expense language, and USD 1,000,000 employer's liability, and § 18.2 adds insurer quality, primacy, cancellation notice and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all Customer-favourable extras. No redline proposed.
